text:
A test-tube contains a volume of 1.0cm3 of liquid water at a temperature of 100°C. The liquid
water boils to form a volume of 1600cm3 of steam.
What is the reason for the large increase in volume?
A
Steam particles are bigger than water particles.
B
The average distance between the particles is much greater in the steam.
C
The particles do not move until the water turns into a gas.
D
There are more steam particles than there were water particles.

options.label: A
options.text: Steam particles are bigger than water particles.

options.label: B
options.text: The average distance between the particles is much greater in the steam.

options.label: C
options.text: The particles do not move until the water turns into a gas.

options.label: D
options.text: There are more steam particles than there were water particles.
